_note: Courses that UC San Diego actually teaches but that catalog.ucsd.edu has
not published yet. scrape-catalog.mjs can only see the General Catalog, so
these would otherwise be dropped by build-catalog.mjs even when the
Schedule of Classes proves they ran (see the 'SoC listings with no catalog
Entries are hand-written in the catalog-scrape.json shape. build-catalog.mjs
only uses an entry when the fresh catalog scrape has no course with the same
normalized id, so each one disappears on its own once UCSD publishes the
real listing. Recheck this file whenever the catalog is re-scraped.
`offerings` here is a fallback used only when the Schedule of Classes
harvest has no evidence for the course; observed quarters always win.

courses.description: This course is designed to prepare transfer students for critical community engagement by introducing both foundational concepts and community-facing writing skills. Students will integrate course material with their lived experience and collegiate academic history in preparation for community partnership and project design. Must be taken for a letter grade to count toward Eighth College general-education requirements. Prerequisites: Eighth College transfer students only.
courses._provenance: https://eighth.ucsd.edu/engagement-program/cce-course-descriptions.html — launching Fall 2026 (four sections on Eighth's tentative FA26 schedule); not in catalog.ucsd.edu/courses/CCE.html or the legacy Schedule of Classes, which ends at SU26.

courses.description: This course focuses on putting the skills acquired in CCE 1-3 or CCE 110 (for transfers) into practice by acting. This project-based capstone course gives students the opportunity to design, develop, and deliver a project in collaboration with local community partners. Attendance is required for lecture and fieldwork sections (e.g., A00 + A01). Must be taken for a letter grade to count toward Eighth College general-education requirements. Prerequisites: Eighth College students only, junior or senior standing; CCE 1, CCE 2, and CCE 3, or CCE 110 for transfer students.
